0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_000010_CID
0.description: Ah, excellent timing! We've just finished our work on the <hex:021A020203>Enterprise<hex:021A020103>. She's so much improved, I've decided to give her a new name to suit:

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_000020_CID
1.description: The <hex:021A020203>Enterprise Excelsior<hex:021A020103>! Or simply the <hex:021A020203>Excelsior<hex:021A020103>, if pressed for time.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_000030_CID
2.description: Once again, she'll carry Eorzea's protectors into battle!

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_000050_EDMONT
4.description: I can do no more than see you off with prayers for your safety and success.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_000060_EDMONT
5.description: Yet know that wheresoever you may go, my son's spirit goes with you. May the Fury grant you strength!

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_100020_ESTINIEN
9.description: Eye of mine enemy! Render unto me thy power!

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_100030_ESTINIEN
10.description: Ugh... No... You will not claim me! I am the master!

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_100060_BIGGS
13.description: Chief! We've got an imperial battleship on our tail! And it's bleedin' <hex:021A020203>massive<hex:021A020103>!

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_100070_CID
14.description: Damn it! The bastards were waiting for us to open the door for them!

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_100080_CID
15.description: I'm going to try to shake them! Hang on to something!

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_100090_WEDGE
16.description: Uwaaaaaah! We're all going to die! Tataruuu!

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_100100_BIGGS
17.description: She won't take much more of this!

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_100110_ICEHEART
18.description: The time is come to use Hydaelyn's gift.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_100120_ICEHEART
19.description: Much blood has been spilled in my name. And for what? For a false cause that I created for want of the warmth of companionship.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_100130_ICEHEART
20.description: Saint Shiva...Hraesvelgr... Pray forgive this fool.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_100140_ICEHEART
21.description: But even now, I cannot let go of my dream─my dream of a tomorrow in which no child need freeze alone in the snow.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_100160_ALPHINAUD
23.description: Is that...Ysayle? What does she mean to do!?

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_100170_ICEHEART
24.description: O goddess born of mine own hopes and dreams.<hex:02100103>For the last time, I beseech you!

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_100180_ICEHEART
25.description: Fill this vessel with your light! Still the hatred<hex:02100103>within our hearts and bless us with eternal grace!

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_100190_ICEHEART
26.description: Farewell, Warrior of Light. And thank you─for showing me the way.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_100210_YSHTOLA
28.description: This aether... It was a Crystal of Light.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_100220_YSHTOLA
29.description: She, too, was one of Hydaelyn's chosen...

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_200010_REGULA
31.description: Our objective lies at the heart of the isle.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_200020_REGULA
32.description: The Third will remain to guard the ship, while the Second patrols the perimeter and eliminates any threats.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_200030_REGULA
33.description: The First will come with me to secure the research facility.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_200040_REGULA
34.description: Let no man doubt the import of our mission: the Allagans found a means to capture eikons alive, and their knowledge lies hid upon this isle.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_200050_REGULA
35.description: If we can but acquire it, we would be able to prevent the beings from returning to plague us, thus ending the cycle of rebirth.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_200060_REGULA
36.description: I need not remind you that success will raise our legion high in the Emperor's regard.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_200070_REGULA
37.description: Yet, by the same token, His Radiance does not tolerate failure. That is all. All troops, prepare for deployment!

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_200090_ALPHINAUD
39.description: To think that the knowledge used to bind no less a being than Bahamut sleeps here...

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_200100_YSHTOLA
40.description: Imprisoning a primal in such a manner would represent an effective means to halt the cycle of summoning─were it not for the grave and obvious risks.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_200110_ALPHINAUD
41.description: Indeed. We need but refer to past experience─that of Bahamut's calamitous return─to see why this is not the solution we seek.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_200120_YSHTOLA
42.description: Held in duress, a primal will continue to nurse its hatred for mankind. And when it inevitably breaks free, its rage will be beyond quelling.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_200130_ESTINIEN
43.description: Whatever folly the Garleans mean to commit, they can wait. We must remain focused on our task.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_200140_ALPHINAUD
44.description: Yes, of course. It would not be polite to keep the archbishop waiting.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_300010_REGULA
45.description: That would explain my men's silence.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_300020_REGULA
46.description: We meet again. And this time, we will not be interrupted.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_300030_REGULA
47.description: Come! Show me your power, champions of Eorzea!

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_400010_REGULA
48.description: I had heard the tales of your strength, Warrior of Light. And now that I have experienced it firsthand, van Baelsar's defeat seems less inexplicable.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_400020_REGULA
49.description: You are a formidable foe, and I have thoroughly enjoyed our time together. Alas, all good things must come to an end. Allagan secrets await, and there is no profit to be had in remaining here.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_400050_YSHTOLA
52.description: It would seem we have no choice.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_400060_ALPHINAUD
53.description: You must continue on. We will hold them here.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_400070_ESTINIEN
54.description: Take the Eye. It should still hold enough energy to be of use to you.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_400080_ESTINIEN
55.description: I shall join you as soon as I am able.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_400090_YSHTOLA
56.description: Enough talk! Make haste and stop the archbishop!

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_500010_TIAMAT
57.description: (-???-)Who cometh to this forsaken place and disturbeth my solitude?

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_500040_MIDGARDSORMR
60.description: None other. My form is such that I may journey with Hydaelyn's chosen─

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_500050_MIDGARDSORMR
61.description: A mortal who desireth to end the war between man and dragon.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_500060_TIAMAT
62.description: (-Tiamat-)Millennia have passed since I was brought low by the men of Allag. To think that war rageth still between our kinds...

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_500070_TIAMAT
63.description: (-Tiamat-)Hearken to my tale, child of man. I am Tiamat, of Midgardsormr's first brood.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_500080_TIAMAT
64.description: (-Tiamat-)In a time before time, my father did come to this star, bearing seven eggs.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_500090_MIDGARDSORMR
65.description: From these eggs did my children hatch. And once they were full-grown, they took wing and spread across all the lands of Hydaelyn.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_500100_TIAMAT
66.description: (-Tiamat-)Together with my brood-brother Bahamut, I journeyed south to Meracydia. And together, we brought forth innumerable children into the world.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_500110_TIAMAT
67.description: (-Tiamat-)We abided in peace, and all was well...until the men of Allag came, some five thousand years since. They slaughtered my children in droves, and took from me my beloved Bahamut.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_500120_TIAMAT
68.description: (-Tiamat-)'Twas then, when I had fallen into the depths of despair, that black-robed men came unto me. The Ascians.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_500130_TIAMAT
69.description: (-Tiamat-)They offered to resurrect Bahamut through their dark arts, and I, in my grief, accepted─a decision which I shall regret unto my dying breath.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_500140_TIAMAT
70.description: (-Tiamat-)For what they brought back was a mockery of my beloved. Worse, the Ascians gifted his murderers the means to entrap him.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_500150_TIAMAT
71.description: (-Tiamat-)Know this, child of man: the beings thy kind call gods are but specters of thy mind's creation, given form at great cost to Hydaelyn.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_500160_TIAMAT
72.description: (-Tiamat-)Many such beings yet slumber across the land, brought to heel by the selfsame empire that bound me. They must not be released into the world.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_500170_TIAMAT
73.description: (-Tiamat-)If thou wouldst end the conflict, vanquish thee the Ascians, and deliver the weak of will from the bonds of their dark influence.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_500180_MIDGARDSORMR
74.description: It hath been five thousand years, my child. Wilt thou not forgive thyself?

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_500190_TIAMAT
75.description: (-Tiamat-)The release of death is denied me here, yet I desire not freedom. Nay, Father. I shall live with my regret until the world itself hath ceased to be.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_500200_TIAMAT
76.description: (-Tiamat-)Such is my just punishment for consorting with Darkness─for calling forth a loathsome and lamentable creature which blackeneth my beloved's memory.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_600020_HYDAELYN
78.description: The Light abideth within thy heart again.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_600030_HYDAELYN
79.description: Full valiantly didst thou overcome thy many trials.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_600040_HYDAELYN
80.description: But glory not in thy success.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_600050_HYDAELYN
81.description: For the servants of Darkness are ever close at hand.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_600060_HYDAELYN
82.description: Receive of me my blessing once more,

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_600070_HYDAELYN
83.description: And go forth, to shine thy Light on all creation.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_700010_MIDGARDSORMR
84.description: Thou hast broken down the wall I built around thee, and partaken of thy mistress's blessing once more.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_700011_MIDGARDSORMR
85.description: Strong art thou, mortal─stronger than any other of thy kind.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_700020_MIDGARDSORMR
86.description: Having looked upon thy deeds, I am convinced. Thou art worthy to bear Her Light.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_700030_MIDGARDSORMR
87.description: The covenant bound me to thee, but 'twould seem our fates were mingled from the first. Though I will not fight thy battles, I will yet lend thee my wings.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_700040_MIDGARDSORMR
88.description: Come, mortal─we go to cast out the Darkness!

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_800020_IGEYOHRM
90.description: Tell me: why do you despise the primals so?

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_800030_IGEYOHRM
91.description: They are the embodiment of mortal will─of mortal desire.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_800040_IGEYOHRM
92.description: Plainly, you <hex:021A020203>desire<hex:021A020103> a foe to despise. And 'tis well<hex:02100103>that you do, for it is from the vortex of ceaseless conflict<hex:02100103>that Lord Zodiark shall be reborn.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_800050_LAHABREA
93.description: Through the Joining, the world shall become whole again.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_800060_LAHABREA
94.description: Then all shall be as once it was─as it should ever have remained.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_800070_IGEYOHRM
95.description: For the glory of Lord Zodiark.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_800080_LAHABREA
96.description: Your meddling ends here and now, Warrior of Light!

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_900010_LAHABREA
97.description: Such strength! It defies all reason...

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_900020_IGEYOHRM
98.description: No! I will not be bested by the likes of them!

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_900040_LAHABREA
100.description: Very well. Let us show these mortals the true power of the Echo...

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_900050_LAHABREA
101.description: The power to break down the barriers of existence!

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_900080_ASCIANPRIME
104.description: Come, mortals! Render up your souls, that Lord Zodiark might be reborn!

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_A00020_ASCIANPRIME
106.description: What walls are these? Arrrgh! Damn you, Hydaelyn!

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_A00030_LAHABREA
107.description: <hex:024804F2022303>That <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> might regain the blessing of Light I had foreseen...<hex:0248020103>

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_A00040_LAHABREA
108.description: <hex:024804F2022303>But <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> is grown so strong in it as to deny us our power.<hex:0248020103>

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_A00050_IGEYOHRM
109.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Let us withdraw, Lahabrea. That power remains to us, at least.<hex:0248020103>

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_A00080_LAHABREA
112.description: <hex:024804F2022303>So you harnessed the Eye's power... A pity you spent it all. What will you do now, hero?<hex:0248020103>

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_A00090_THORDAN
113.description: So, not even the vaunted Warrior of Light can unmake an Ascian without relying upon mortal contrivances.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_A00110_THORDAN
115.description: In the distant past, King Thordan and his knights twelve fought and defeated Nidhogg.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_A00120_THORDAN
116.description: Though the victory cost them dear, they were rewarded with a great prize: the dread wyrm's eyes, both of which have since been held in the Holy See's safekeeping.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_A00130_THORDAN
117.description: The Eye you possess was Nidhogg's left, and long has it served as the source of the Azure Dragoon's might. As for its twin...

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_A00140_THORDAN
118.description: It has lain here, joined to the person of Haldrath, the first Azure Dragoon. For though he learned to harness its power, he was ultimately consumed by it. Even in death, his body decays not─a pitiful end for a fabled hero.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_A00150_THORDAN
119.description: My Ascian friend. Long have you and your kind sown the seeds of chaos by teaching mortals the secrets of summoning.

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_A00160_THORDAN
120.description: But if you assumed that we would meekly serve as your pawns, then you are gravely mistaken.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_A00170_LAHABREA
121.description: <hex:024804F2022303>You would raise a hand against us!?<hex:0248020103>

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_A00180_THORDAN
122.description: By taking unto my flesh the soul of the legendary King Thordan, I am become a god─

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_A00190_THORDAN
123.description: A god who knows not cessation, whose being is sustained by a millennium of fervent prayer and the Eye's nigh-bottomless reservoir of aether.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_A00210_THORDAN
125.description: Your contempt for man has proven your undoing, Ascian. For my first act as god-king, I do hereby sentence you to die.

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_A00230_THORDAN
127.description: Gods feed upon aether. It matters not what form that aether takes. Ascian souls are no exception. With this power, I shall put an end to a thousand years of conflict.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_A00240_THORDAN
128.description: Be they sown by Ascian, dragon, or primal, wheresoever the seeds of chaos threaten to quicken, I shall excise them with my divine blade and bring order to the world.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_A00250_THORDAN
129.description: I am become that which you abhor, Warrior of Light. If you would take issue with my godhood, I shall answer you with my blade.

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_B00010_ZEPHIRIN
130.description: Brothers! The time is come to call upon the true power of the Heavens' Ward!

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_B00020_THORDAN
131.description: Fight me if you will, Warrior of Light.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_B00030_THORDAN
132.description: I care not. All who stand against me will be destroyed─<hex:02100103>be they servants of the Darkness or the Light.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_B00040_THORDAN
133.description: By my blessing shall all men be sanctified, and an endless era<hex:02100103>of peace begin. Vice and conflict shall cease to be.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_B00050_THORDAN
134.description: You reject my divinity, yet what have you to offer<hex:02100103>my people in its stead? Bitter truth? Virtuous suffering?

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_B00060_THORDAN
135.description: No matter. If you believe your cause just,<hex:02100103>I call upon you to defend it with your life!

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_C00010_THORDAN
136.description: How...how can this be? A millennium of prayer<hex:02100103>and the Eye's power combined─and still you stand?

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_C00030_ESTINIEN
138.description: ...It is over, then? I had hoped that mine would be the hand to end it...but knowing you, there was little chance of that.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_C00040_ESTINIEN
139.description: 'Twould seem the Eye has served you well.

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_C00060_ESTINIEN
141.description: All that remains is to take them beyond the reach of man and dragon both. With this task accomplished, my toils shall finally be at an end.

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_C00070_NIDHOGG
142.description: Thou hadst done well to resist mine influence, bathed in my power and blood as thou wert.

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_C00080_NIDHOGG
143.description: Alas, in thine anticipation of comfort, thou hast lowered thy guard!

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_C00090_NIDHOGG
144.description: The keening of my fallen kindred... Their smoldering desire for vengeance...

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_C00100_NIDHOGG
145.description: Mine eyes have partaken of a thousand years of pain─a pain which I shall bestow upon thee.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_C00110_NIDHOGG
146.description: Drink deep of my rage, mortal...AND BECOME ME!

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_C00130_MIDGARDSORMR
148.description: Nidhogg, my child... What hath thy fury made of thee...?

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_C00140_MIDGARDSORMR
149.description: Let us away, servant of Hydaelyn.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_D00030_CID
152.description: Haha! Godsdammit, do you always have to cut it so bloody close!?

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_D00040_YSHTOLA
153.description: It would seem <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> has done it again.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_D00060_ALPHINAUD
155.description: Let us return to Ishgard. Our friends will be eager to learn the battle's outcome...and welcome back their champion.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_E00010_AYMERIC
157.description: I daresay you are the first soul in Ishgardian history to arrive in our city upon dragonback. This scene shall be remembered for a thousand years to come.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_E00020_ALPHINAUD
158.description: As we had feared, the archbishop summoned the soul of King Thordan unto himself and thence became a primal.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_E00030_YSHTOLA
159.description: But he and his knights are no more, thanks to the Warrior of Light.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_E00040_MIDGARDSORMR
160.description: Your struggles are not yet over, mortals.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_E00050_AYMERIC
161.description: Whom do I have the pleasure...?

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_E00060_MIDGARDSORMR
162.description: I am Midgardsormr. I have journeyed with Hydaelyn's champion and observed <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> deeds in the conflict between man and dragon.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_E00070_MIDGARDSORMR
163.description: Tell me, children of Thordan. Do you desire peace?

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_E00080_AYMERIC
164.description: My people have committed unspeakable atrocities against dragonkind─even against our own. Would that we could undo these wrongs...but we cannot.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_E00090_AYMERIC
165.description: Be that as it may, the future yet presents a chance to begin anew. Our nation has broken free of the shackles of a false faith, and Nidhogg shall lead his kindred against us no more.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_E00100_AYMERIC
166.description: I doubt not that it will require much effort and perseverance, but 'tis my belief that, in time, Ishgard will again become a place where man and dragon may abide together in harmony.

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_E00120_MIDGARDSORMR
168.description: Yet be warned: Nidhogg's soul liveth on.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_E00130_MIDGARDSORMR
169.description: His unbridled rage hath claimed for its vessel the one thou callest the Azure Dragoon.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_E00150_MIDGARDSORMR
171.description: Doubt not but that Nidhogg will call out to his brood ere long, nor that they shall answer him.

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_E00160_MIDGARDSORMR
172.description: Steel yourselves, for the true test is yet to come.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_E00170_AYMERIC
173.description: Come what may, we will never cease to believe.

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_E00180_AYMERIC
174.description: Upon the souls of they who have sacrificed themselves to pave the way for peace, we will never abandon our cause.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_E00190_MIDGARDSORMR
175.description: A thousand-year war cannot be ended in a day. It may take generations. What thou dost begin, thy children must continue.

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03007_E00200_MIDGARDSORMR
176.description: Entrust unto them thy hopes and dreams, that peace may reign again...and forevermore.
